sonicScene.thesis: The Golden Passage: you fly through an endless luminous sculpture of sacred geometry, rose-window gates strung on twelve helical rails; a chord lights its own polygon of rails down the whole passage, the kick sends a wave of light ahead of you, the bass widens the passage.

composition.background: the gold sun at the vanishing point, the far gates dissolving into its glow
composition.midground: gates receding and turning along the helical rails; enormous rings outside in the haze
composition.foreground: the nearest gate sweeping past the frame; the inner tunnel of triangles
composition.atmosphere: indigo haze that turns gold toward the sun
composition.post: bloom; a radial burst on the kick
composition.camera: flying forward through the passage, a little off its axis, banking slowly

palette.background_value: near black (indigo), gold at the vanishing point
palette.saturation: gold and ivory light; vermilion only on the star's bloom

vocabulary: STRUCTURE: the passage widens and narrows; the outer rings expand
a wave of light runs down the passage from you to the sun; a surge forward
the gates' stars bloom open and flash vermilion; sparks stream past
sparks stream past along the walls
the whole lattice turns (the twist's phase)
gold turns toward ivory and white
STRUCTURE: the gates double (a gate every 7 m)
each of the twelve rails is a pitch class: a chord lights its polygon down the whole passage
STRUCTURE: every rose's open heart becomes a vermilion polygon with as many sides as notes sounding
the sun's colour: deep orange (low) to white gold (high)
how bright a note flares the gates' circles
the enormous outer rings glow while notes are held
the flight goes on, slow and golden
sonicScene.tier: light: instanced thin tori and tubes, unlit, one material program, analytic fog, bloom
sonicScene.title: Sacred Geometry Flight
